description: Surfaced by fz-t93 (2026-07-15) once the missing frontmatter let the fixture run. fixtures2/behavior/opaque_fn_all_divergent.fz: dbg(:bad + 1) (ill-typed atom+int add). interp: aborts with function_clause: no backend entry clause matched for executable 1 (correct-ish: loud). run+build: exit 0 with COMPLETELY EMPTY stdout/stderr -- the expression is silently swallowed, no output, no diagnostic, no abort. Three-path parity break AND a silent-failure class: native producing silent nothing for code that must either diagnose at compile time or crash loudly at runtime. Likely the native lowering prunes the divergent/absent-return path entirely (all clauses divergent -> body pruned -> main emits nothing) where interp still dispatches and faults. Decide the CONTRACT first (compile-time diagnostic? runtime function_clause abort like interp?) then make all three paths agree. Repro: fixture_matrix opaque_fn_all_divergent (interp red = honest signal; run/build green-but-wrong).

comments.text:
DIAGNOSIS SPIKE COMPLETE (2026-07-15, branch wt/bdk-spike @ 99071ece8 -- probe fixtures + README under fixtures2/spikes/fz-bdk/, keep for the fix). CHAMPION AGGRAVATOR p7: dbg(1); dbg(:bad+1); dbg(2) -> native prints 1 then exits 0 SILENTLY (real side effects up to the fault, then all evidence discarded; same exit code as success). 8-probe matrix: native never fabricates wrong data -- the failure class is silent-truncation, not corruption.

ROT POINT (evidence chain, classification (c) at the PROCESS-EXIT BOUNDARY -- everything upstream is CORRECT): the type layer's is_empty/diverges fact is right (artifact.rs:2616,2631), NoReturn propagates through seal_return_flow + native lowering correctly, and the compiled program CONTAINS a genuine reachable Halt(function_clause) (verified via --dump native + the already-green drive_test compiler2_all_divergent_public_callable_has_no_result_continuation which observes halt_value=function_clause via process_exited telemetry). THE BREAK: neither production driver reads the fault -- Compiler2::run_root_jit (compiler.rs:319-331) does run_until_idle(); Ok(()) never inspecting halt_value; fz_aot_run_main (runtime/src/aot_shim.rs:552-593) ALWAYS returns 0. Interp differs only because its fault is a Rust Err propagating to the CLI. Native unifies fault-halt with normal completion by design, so nothing downstream distinguishes them.

SOLUTION (design, implementation-ready, small): tag exit-kind AT SOURCE -- Process gains structural exit_kind ExitKind{Normal, Fault(atom_id)}, set ONLY by the emit_halt/halt_with_atom path (never used for normal returns; do NOT infer from the halted VALUE -- a user can legitimately return :function_clause). run_root_jit checks exit_kind after run_until_idle -> Err via the existing CliError::failure path (parity with interp); fz_aot_run_main checks (*proc).exit_kind -> stderr diagnostic + nonzero exit. CANNOT regress DCE: orthogonal to pruning (only changes what a KEPT, EXECUTED trap reports). Tests: promote opaque_fn_all_divergent + the p7 shape to fz2_cli asserting nonzero exit + function_clause stderr on run AND the built binary; whole green corpus still exits 0. Shape: Process field + one codegen call + two driver sites.

title: native run/build SILENTLY swallow ill-typed expression (exit 0, empty output) where interp aborts function_clause -- opaque_fn_all_divergent parity + silent-failure bug
